newsitem.title: ITALY: Albanian plane lands in Italy, pilots seek asylum.
newsitem.headline: Albanian plane lands in Italy, pilots seek asylum.

text.p: An Albanian military plane landed in southern Italy on Tuesday and its two pilots asked for political asylum, the Ansa news agency reported.
The report said the plane landed in the southern town of Galatina, across the southern Adriatic from Albania. No further details were immediately available.
The agency said the plane was a "Mig" with two Albanian military on board. They had the rank of major and captain.
Albania has been in a state of chaos in the past few weeks because of popular protests sparked by the collapse of pyramid investment schemes.
Troops are enforcing emergency rule in an effort to stamp out violent unrest that has sent the southern part of Europe's poorest country reeling out of control.
